title: Arkansas Trust Network
doctrine: We will work with anyone acting in good faith to improve Arkansas — not agreement, partnership. Cross-party relationship building for election integrity, civic function, and community trust.
objective: Build relationships with Republicans, independents, business leaders, election officials, and civic leaders statewide.

relationshipTypes.label: Republican leaders
relationshipTypes.prompt: County party chairs, business Republicans open to election integrity

relationshipTypes.label: Independents
relationshipTypes.prompt: Unaffiliated civic leaders, chamber members, Rotarians

relationshipTypes.label: Business leaders
relationshipTypes.prompt: Employers, downtown alliances, main street advocates

relationshipTypes.label: Election officials
relationshipTypes.prompt: County clerks, election commissioners — competence posture

relationshipTypes.label: Civic leaders
relationshipTypes.prompt: Nonprofit heads, faith leaders acting in civic capacity

searcyCountyPilot.label: Searcy County outright win (50%+1)
searcyCountyPilot.note: Trust network is force multiplier for cross-partisan credibility in North Central Ozarks counties.
